decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core skincare range with its own dedicated page, it likely meets or comes close to aspiration levels, and in a growing market the firm has enough slack to keep testing it.

Although its weaker website prominence suggests more uncertain traction than Product A, it fits the established offer well, so absent clear signs of underperformance management would likely retain it for now.

This cleansing product is closely aligned with the firm’s existing natural facial-care business, and with no visible evidence of failure a small but experienced firm would more likely keep it than redeploy resources immediately.
